binding.boundary: mermaid_flutter.renderToPng(source, pixelRatio: 1) in the sealed release drawing target under a private Xvfb display; in-app PNG admission as DaveBench

corpus.seed: reviewed Terminal Drawing Facts, invalid controls excluded

method: Label assessment: SVG labels must pass browser visibility, canvas and clipping checks, or a bounded pixel comparison proving the complete original glyphs remain visible against their actual backdrop. Unsupported observations remain unassessed. Terminal labels retain their reading order, with wrapping joined within observed frames; a label found only as whole words wrapped across successive rows outside a frame has no established owner and is unknown, not missing. Clipping measured in a fallback face because the declared primary font is not installed is environment-dependent and unavailable, not failed; assessmentEnvironments records the fontconfig families that judged the run. Raw Mermaid syntax is rejected. Edges, arrow direction, layout and styling are not scored. PNG is assessed only for a project whose own interface draws PNG and that has no SVG or terminal output, under the weaker png-ocr-presence-only-v1 profile: a label-blind OCR reader must read every label whole in confident words for a pass; an unread label is unknown, never missing; raw syntax read confidently, a uniform raster or ink on an empty diagram fail; absence of raw syntax is observed, not proved.

method.scope: Applicable obligations come from each case's reviewed source contract and regression geometry list. A category passes only when every applicable obligation in it passed, fails when any failed, and is otherwise unassessed. No drawing (renderer failure, inadmissible output) is a known nonpass. The ranked label verdict is unchanged.

manualReview.selectionRule: Lanes: the top 8 SVG and top 6 terminal projects by published label passes (ties alphabetical). In each lane: (1) every label-unknown row; (2) three sampled mechanical failures with a drawing, label-incorrect rows first and then rows with a failed obligation category; (3) one sampled row whose obligation category was left unassessed in a structure-profiled family (flowchart, class, state, ER, sequence). Samples are taken in ascending sha256 of "project|format|caseId". wevm/ondine additionally has every label-unknown and label-incorrect row and every obligation failure with a drawing reviewed, in both formats. Renderer failures and inadmissible outputs have no drawing to review. Each verdict concerns the named aspect only: labels, or one obligation category.
manualReview.policy: Reviews are recorded beside the mechanical verdicts. They never erase a mechanical failure and never turn an unknown into a ranked pass; a mechanical failure that looks drawn correctly is listed as a candidate observer defect.
